title: Your Grocery Bill and Loan EMIs: Understanding India's Rising Inflation
description: India's retail inflation, measured by the Consumer Price Index (CPI), rose to 5.54% in September 2026. This increase was mainly driven by higher prices for ev.

faq.q: What is the current retail inflation rate in India?
faq.a: India's retail inflation, as measured by the Consumer Price Index (CPI), stood at 5.54% in September 2026.

faq.q: What is the RBI's target for inflation?
faq.a: The Reserve Bank of India is mandated to keep retail inflation at 4%, with a permissible band of 2% on either side, meaning between 2% and 6%.

faq.q: What is the current repo rate?
faq.a: Following the RBI's October 2026 monetary policy meeting, the benchmark repo rate was increased to 5.50%.

faq.q: Will my loan EMIs definitely go up?
faq.a: If you have a loan with a floating interest rate, your EMIs are likely to increase as banks adjust their lending rates in response to the RBI's repo rate hike. For fixed-rate loans, your EMIs will remain unchanged.

faq.q: How long is inflation expected to remain high?
faq.a: The RBI expects inflation to remain elevated over the next two to three months, with upside risks to its forecast, especially if food and energy prices remain high.
